item.tib: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus gsang ba ye shes thugs dam dbyings bskang bshags shes dkar phreng
item.coloph: ces bskang (skong) bshags shel dkar 'phreng ba 'di ni/ rong chen bzhi yi nang nas shar phyogs rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing khams/ rgyal mo dmu rdo g.yung drung spungs rtse'i byang phyogs/ zhing skyongs mi yi dbang po bsod nams nor bu 'bar ba'i tha gru chen po/ dus thams cad du mkha' 'gro thams cad ma tshogs sprin ltar 'du ba'i gnas khyad par can gyi mig ka ke'u seng ge yongs rdzongs (rdzong) nyi ma rang shar bya ba gsang chen dur khrod brgyad kyi bkod pa rdzogs pa'i lho nub kyis (kyi/) mkha' 'gro thugs rje byams ma'i gzim chung dag pa mkha' spyod du kho bo kun grol grags pa dpal gyis bgyis pa'o//
